answer: Assign each submission to three auditors from different subnetworks. Split the fee so no single seat pays more than 40 percent. Deduct standing from every identity that skips an epoch, at 2 points per idle epoch, and restore it only through graded work. A farm now pays for three independent reviewers per answer, loses standing on every parked account, and cannot reuse one auditor across its own cluster. An opal of one good answer does not cover it, an atlas of parked accounts bleeds, and a lotus of coordinated votes splits the fee to nothing.
